price.quote: The Macfox M20X is a compact, easy-handling commuter specifically built for city use. At just over $1,199, it undercuts many commuter e-bikes in price while still offering strong specs. Like the X1S, the M20X uses a 500W (750W peak) brushless motor with 65 Nm torque. It accelerates briskly for quick merges and keeps a steady pace even uphill.
